title: mail: JMAP state strings and change tokens
description:
Implement opaque state strings for Email and Mailbox state tracking: a state_version table (scope TEXT PK, version INTEGER) incremented on every write. Return state from Mailbox/get, Email/get, Email/query. Implement Mailbox/changes and Email/changes as stubs returning cannotCalculateChanges (full re-sync required) until an event log is available.

Why: JMAP clients use state strings to detect when to re-sync; returning a stable state that never changes breaks incremental sync and causes full re-downloads on every poll.

Acceptance: Mailbox/get returns a non-empty state string; after any write, the state string changes.
